message.content: {"label":"sufficient","reason":"Evidence across passages explicitly describes DoorDash revenue sources: Marketplace revenue with partner merchant commissions and consumer fees; DashPass subscription revenue; Drive per-order fees; and DashPass within Marketplace.","supported_requirements":[{"requirement":"DoorDash generates substantial majority of revenue from the DoorDash Marketplace, via commissions to partner merchants and fees to consumers.","passage_rank":3,"quote":"The Company generates a substantial majority of its revenue from orders completed through the DoorDash Marketplace and the related commissions charged to partner merchants and fees charged to consumers."},{"requirement":"Revenue from DashPass subscriptions is recognized over the contractual period and is part of Marketplace revenue.","passage_rank":3,"quote":"Revenue from the membership fees paid by consumers for DashPass, which is recognized as part of the DoorDash Marketplace. Revenue generated from the Company’s DashPass subscriptions is recognized on a ratable basis over the contractual period, which is generally one month to one year depending on the type of subscription purchased by the consumer."},{"requirement":"Drive generates revenue from per-order fees charged to merchants using DoorDash's local logistics platform.","passage_rank":3,"quote":"Revenue from Drive is recognized at the point in time when the consumer obtains control of the merchant’s products. When determining the appropriate accounting for the fees collected in exchange for the use of the Company’s local logistics platform, the Company considered its contractual arrangements with the parties involved as well as its customary business practices. Under the Company’s agreements with partner merchants, the Company agrees to a commission to be earned as a percentage of the total dollar value of goods ordered."},{"requirement":"DoorDash offers DashPad within the Marketplace as a subscription product with benefits.","passage_rank":1,"quote":"the Marketplace also includes DashPass, the Company’s subscription product, which provides consumers with unlimited access to eligible merchants with zero delivery fees and reduced service fees."}],"missing_requirements":[],"concerns":[]}
